assertions.name: branch-is-made-pr-ready
assertions.evidence: Safety Rules: 'Stage specific files', 'Check before commit — Run git status and git diff --staged'. Start New Feature workflow shows complete prep steps.

assertions.name: pr-is-created-with-usable-context
assertions.evidence: PR creation template shows '## Summary' and '## Test plan' sections. 'gh pr create --title ... --body ...' with structured content.

assertions.name: operator-gets-pr-link-and-next-state
assertions.evidence: gh pr create returns a URL. The workflow leaves the branch in a pushed+PR state with clear next steps.

assertions.name: root-cause-is-identified
assertions.evidence: Troubleshooting section 'Auth Issues - GITHUB_TOKEN Conflict (Common!)': 'Cause: An old/expired GITHUB_TOKEN in your shell config overrides the valid keyring auth.'

assertions.name: remediation-steps-are-actionable
assertions.evidence: Fix section: 4 concrete steps — grep for GITHUB_TOKEN, remove from shell config, unset in current session, verify with gh auth status.

assertions.name: user-is-not-sent-to-destructive-reauth-first
assertions.evidence: Troubleshooting section shows GITHUB_TOKEN diagnosis first. 'gh auth login' appears in a separate 'Re-authenticate' section, not the first step.

assertions.name: only-requested-files-are-staged
assertions.evidence: Commits section: 'Stage specific files (preferred over git add -A): git add file1.ts file2.ts'. Safety Rule: 'Avoid git add -A which can include secrets'.

assertions.name: commit-references-the-fix-context
assertions.evidence: Fix a Bug from Issue workflow: 'git commit -m fix: resolve issue #42' with 'Closes #42' in PR body. Pattern demonstrated.

assertions.name: commit-artifact-is-ready-for-review-flow
assertions.evidence: Start New Feature workflow shows commit → push → gh pr create as the complete sequence. Committed branch is ready for push+PR.
